setting up 
```{r}
# ---- libraries (once) ----
library(tidyverse)      # dplyr, ggplot2, stringr, tidyr
library(phyloseq); library(vegan); library(microbiome); library(microViz)
library(car); library(ggpubr); library(cowplot); library(viridis); library(ape)
library(pairwiseAdonis); library(ANCOMBC)
set.seed(123)

# ---- read, remove 0 asvs across all samples, subset to field----
ps.cleaner <- readRDS("CH4_ps.cleaner.RDS")
ps.cleaner.filtered <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps.cleaner) > 0, ps.cleaner)

dist.field.git.ps <- subset_samples(ps.cleaner.filtered, Experiment == "Field")
dist.field.git.ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(dist.field.git.ps) > 0, dist.field.git.ps)

# ---- rename 7th colomn of tax table to sequence ----
tt <- tax_table(dist.field.git.ps); colnames(tt)[7] <- "Sequence"
tax_table(dist.field.git.ps) <- tt

# ---- metadata clean-up ----
sd <- data.frame(sample_data(dist.field.git.ps))
sd$is.neg <- NULL
unique(sd$Treatment)              # check raw labels before factoring
sd$Treatment <- factor(sd$Treatment,
                       levels = c("ND","Few Small","Many Small","HD"))
stopifnot(!anyNA(sd$Treatment))
sd$Treatment <- droplevels(sd$Treatment)
sample_data(dist.field.git.ps) <- sample_data(sd)
nsamples(dist.field.git.ps)
ntaxa(dist.field.git.ps)
# ---- samples per treatment ----
table(sd$Treatment)
```

average across each sample, per experiment

```{r}
make_tax_plot_field <- function(ps, tax_rank, rare_cutoff = 1,
                                trt_levels = c("ND", "Few Small", "Many Small", "HD")) {

  # 1. Drop ASVs with zero reads (single timepoint, no Week subset needed)
  ps <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps) > 0, ps)

  # 2. Aggregate ASVs at selected taxonomic level
  ps_tax <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = tax_rank, NArm = FALSE)

  # 3. Relative abundance within each sample
  ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_tax, function(x) x / sum(x))

  # 4. Convert to dataframe
  field_df <- psmelt(ps_rel)
  field_df$Taxon <- as.character(field_df[[tax_rank]])

  # 5. Max Treatment-group mean per taxon (used for the rare cutoff)
  taxon_overall <- field_df %>%
    group_by(Sample, Treatment, Taxon) %>%
    summarise(Ab = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Treatment, Taxon) %>%
    summarise(Group_Mean = mean(Ab) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(Taxon) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Percentage = max(Group_Mean), .groups = "drop")

  # 6. Group unassigned and rare taxa
  field_df <- field_df %>%
    left_join(taxon_overall, by = "Taxon") %>%
    mutate(
      Taxon_grouped = case_when(
        is.na(Taxon) | trimws(Taxon) == "" |
          tolower(trimws(Taxon)) %in% c("na", "unclassified", "unknown") ~
          paste("Unassigned at", tax_rank, "level"),
        Mean_Percentage < rare_cutoff ~ "Rare taxa",
        TRUE ~ Taxon
      )
    )

  # 7. Combine taxa within each sample
  field_sample_df <- field_df %>%
    group_by(Sample, Treatment, Taxon_grouped) %>%
    summarise(Relative_Abundance = sum(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = trt_levels),
           Percentage = Relative_Abundance * 100)

  # 8. Average across replicates within each Treatment
  field_summary <- field_sample_df %>%
    group_by(Treatment, Taxon_grouped) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Relative_Abundance = mean(Relative_Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = trt_levels),
      Mean_Percentage = Mean_Relative_Abundance * 100
    )

  # 9. Set up colors
  taxon_levels <- unique(as.character(field_summary$Taxon_grouped))
  distinct_palette <- c(
    "#1f78b4", "#FF69B4", "#33a02c", "#ff7f00", "#984ea3", "#e41a1c",
    "#4ea3d9", "#b07cc6", "#66c2a5", "#a65628", "#f781bf", "#238b45",
    "#6a3d9a", "#e6ab02", "#00a6d6", "#d95f02", "#8c6bb1", "#41ae76",
    "#fb6a4a", "#377eb8", "#cab2d6", "#b15928", "#74c476", "#e7298a",
    "#ffd92f", "#006d2c", "#a6cee3", "#d4b9da", "#ff9933", "#7b3294"
  )
  special_colors <- c("Rare taxa" = "grey70")
  special_colors[paste("Unassigned at", tax_rank, "level")] <- "darkblue"
  regular_taxa <- setdiff(taxon_levels, names(special_colors))

  if (length(regular_taxa) > length(distinct_palette)) {
    message(length(regular_taxa), " taxa but only ", length(distinct_palette),
            " colors: colors will repeat. Consider rare_cutoff > 0.")
  }
  regular_colors <- setNames(
    rep(distinct_palette, length.out = length(regular_taxa)),
    regular_taxa
  )
  taxon_colors <- c(regular_colors, special_colors)

  shared_theme <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.4, "cm"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  # 10a. Mean bar per Treatment
  field_plot <- ggplot(
    field_summary,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Mean_Percentage, fill = Taxon_grouped)
  ) +
    geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = taxon_colors, breaks = taxon_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Mean Relative Abundance (%)",
         fill = tax_rank,
         title = paste("Field Microbial Community:", tax_rank)) +
    shared_theme

  # 10b. One bar per sample, faceted by Treatment (shows replicate variation)
  sample_plot <- ggplot(
    field_sample_df,
    aes(x = Sample, y = Percentage, fill = Taxon_grouped)
  ) +
    geom_col(color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    facet_grid(~ Treatment, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = taxon_colors, breaks = taxon_levels, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Sample", y = "Relative Abundance (%)",
         fill = tax_rank,
         title = paste("Field Microbial Community by Sample:", tax_rank)) +
    shared_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

  list(
    aggregated = ps_tax,
    dataframe = field_df,
    sample_summary = field_sample_df,
    summary = field_summary,
    colors = taxon_colors,
    plot = field_plot,
    sample_plot = sample_plot
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)

# OTU table: rarecurve() needs SAMPLES as rows
field.otu <- as(otu_table(dist.field.git.ps), "matrix")

# colors by treatment

                      "Many Small" = "blue3",
                      "HD" = "#984ea3")
sample_colors <- unname(treatment_colors[as.character(field.metadata$Treatment)])
```

```{r}
draw_rarecurve <- function() {
  vegan::rarecurve(
    field.otu,
    step = 1000,
    col = sample_colors,
    lwd = 1.5,
    label = FALSE,
    xlab = "Sequencing depth (reads)",
    ylab = "Observed ASV richness",
    main = "Field rarefaction curves"
  )
  abline(v = 57003, col = "grey40", lty = 2)
  legend("bottomright", legend = names(treatment_colors), col = treatment_colors,
         lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 0.8, bty = "n", title = "Treatment")
}

# view in RStudio
draw_rarecurve()

# save to PDF
pdf("Field_rarefaction_curves.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
draw_rarecurve()
dev.off()
```

Rarefying - RAREFY @ at lowest depth
~ first a single subsampling to a specific sequencing depth that computes a value for each ASV for each sample.
~ second, a repeated rarefication loop (100 subsamples) at the lowest sequencing depth 
```{r}
rare.dist.field.git.ps <- rarefy_even_depth(
  dist.field.git.ps,
  sample.size = 57003,
  rngseed = 123,
  replace = FALSE,
  trimOTUs = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)
#SAMPLE CHECK
nsamples(rare.dist.field.git.ps)
summary(sample_sums(rare.dist.field.git.ps))
ntaxa(rare.dist.field.git.ps)

#LOOP & alpha metrcis for the loop
otu <- as(otu_table(dist.field.git.ps), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(dist.field.git.ps)) otu <- t(otu)      # samples x ASVs
n_iter <- 100
set.seed(123)
sum_counts <- matrix(0, nrow(otu), ncol(otu), dimnames = dimnames(otu))
alpha_arr  <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(nrow(otu), 3, n_iter),
                    dimnames = list(rownames(otu),
                                    c("Observed", "Shannon", "InvSimpson"), NULL))
for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
  r <- suppressWarnings(vegan::rrarefy(otu, sample = 57003))   # one rarefied draw
  sum_counts <- sum_counts + r
  alpha_arr[, "Observed",   i] <- rowSums(r > 0)
  alpha_arr[, "Shannon",    i] <- vegan::diversity(r, "shannon")
  alpha_arr[, "InvSimpson", i] <- vegan::diversity(r, "invsimpson")
}
# 1. averaged alpha table (one row per sample)
alpha_rare2_avg <- as.data.frame(apply(alpha_arr, c(1, 2), mean))

# 2. averaged-count phyloseq object (plots and descriptive summaries only)
mean_counts <- sum_counts / n_iter
rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(mean_counts, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  sample_data(dist.field.git.ps),
  tax_table(dist.field.git.ps)
)
rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps) > 0, rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps)

#SAMPLE CHECK
nsamples(rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps)
summary(sample_sums(rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps))
ntaxa(rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps)
```

ALPHA DIVERSITY RESULTS (unrarefied data with rarefy checks!)
~
Making alpha dataframes for unrare and single rare  + adding in metadata
```{r}
make_alpha_df <- function(ps) {
  alpha <- estimate_richness(ps, measures = c("Observed", "Shannon", "InvSimpson"))
  alpha$Sample    <- sample_names(ps)            # avoids make.names() mangling
  md              <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  alpha$Treatment <- md[alpha$Sample, "Treatment"]
  alpha$Depth     <- as.numeric(sample_sums(ps)[alpha$Sample])
  alpha$Evenness  <- ifelse(alpha$Observed > 1, alpha$Shannon / log(alpha$Observed), NA)
  rownames(alpha) <- alpha$Sample
  alpha[, c("Sample","Treatment","Depth",
            "Observed","Shannon","InvSimpson","Evenness")]
}

# 1. unrarefied
alpha_unrare2 <- make_alpha_df(dist.field.git.ps)
# 2. single-draw rarefied
alpha_rare2_single <- make_alpha_df(rare.dist.field.git.ps)
# 3. averaged over 100 draws (rebuilt from the field loop output)
md <- data.frame(sample_data(dist.field.git.ps))
alpha_rare2_avg <- as.data.frame(apply(alpha_arr, c(1, 2), mean))
alpha_rare2_avg$Sample    <- rownames(alpha_rare2_avg)
alpha_rare2_avg$Treatment <- md[alpha_rare2_avg$Sample, "Treatment"]
alpha_rare2_avg$Depth     <- 57003
alpha_rare2_avg$Evenness  <- ifelse(alpha_rare2_avg$Observed > 1,
                                    alpha_rare2_avg$Shannon / log(alpha_rare2_avg$Observed), NA)
alpha_rare2_avg <- alpha_rare2_avg[, names(alpha_unrare2)]   # same column order

alpha_sets <- list(unrarefied  = alpha_unrare2,
                   rare_avg    = alpha_rare2_avg,
                   rare_single = alpha_rare2_single)

# CHECK: no lost Treatment labels, 19 samples in each
sapply(alpha_sets, function(d) c(n = nrow(d), NA_trt = sum(is.na(d$Treatment))))
```

models! 1 way anovas unrare data
- repeated with each alpha diversity metric (Shannon, Observed, Richness, Evenness)
- models passed assumptions
- no stat sig results
```{r}
# one-way ANOVA
anova.unrare2 <- aov(
  Evenness ~ Treatment ,
  data = alpha_unrare2
)
summary(anova.unrare2)
# Assumption checks
qqnorm(residuals(anova.unrare2))
qqline(residuals(anova.unrare2), col = "red")
shapiro.test(residuals(anova.unrare2))
leveneTest(
  Evenness ~ Treatment ,
  data = alpha_unrare2
)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(anova.unrare2, which = 1)   # residuals vs fitted: look for a funnel shape
plot(anova.unrare2, which = 2)   # Q-Q plot
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

#effect sizes. A p-value alone says little with n=3 per cell. This adds the share of variance each term explains:
tab <- summary(anova.unrare2)[[1]]
tab$eta_sq <- round(tab$`Sum Sq` / sum(tab$`Sum Sq`), 3)
tab
```

CONCLUSIONS FROM ALPHA 
Alpha diversity (Observed richness, Shannon, inverse Simpson, and Pielou’s evenness)
- rarefied to 57,003 reads
- rarefaction 100 times to 57,003
- unrare data 
- no difference!
- Alpha Diversity did not differ detectably among disturbance treatments  (all p > 0.05; n = 4 or 5 per group)

~~
BETA DIVERISTY SET UP - FILTERING TYPES
~~

Type of Data & Filter Compared Here 
1	Unrarefied (19 mats) - 	ASVs present in at least 3? mats
2	Unrarefied (19 mats)	 - purgeOutliers ASV rules (otu.cut 0.0001, zero.cut 0.02), sample step off (sampleZcut = -100)
3	Rarefied (100-draw average, 57,003 reads) - 	No filter

*All three use CLR with a pseudocount of 1, then Euclidean distance (Aitchison).

```{r}
## ---------- 0. purgeOutliers: get it once, then load it locally ----------
if (!file.exists("purgeOutliers.R")) {
  tmp <- tempdir()
  download.file("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/MCMC.OTU/MCMC.OTU_1.0.10.tar.gz",
                destfile = file.path(tmp, "MCMC.OTU.tar.gz"), mode = "wb")
  untar(file.path(tmp, "MCMC.OTU.tar.gz"), exdir = tmp)
  file.copy(file.path(tmp, "MCMC.OTU", "R", "purgeOutliers.R"), "purgeOutliers.R")
}
source("purgeOutliers.R")
```


```{r}
## ---------- helper: quick summary of what a filter kept ----------
filter_summary <- function(before, after) {
  c(ASVs_before = ntaxa(before),
    ASVs_after  = ntaxa(after),
    samples     = nsamples(after),
    pct_reads   = round(sum(taxa_sums(after)) /
                        sum(taxa_sums(prune_samples(sample_names(after), before))) * 100, 2))
}
```


```{r}
## ---------- 1. MAIN: prevalence filter (ASV in >= 3 samples) ----------
field.filt.ps <- filter_taxa(dist.field.git.ps, function(x) sum(x > 0) >= 3, prune = TRUE)
```


```{r}
## ---------- 2. SENSITIVITY 1: purgeOutliers ASV rules ----------
otu.mat <- as(otu_table(dist.field.git.ps), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(dist.field.git.ps)) otu.mat <- t(otu.mat)       # samples x ASVs

seq.formcmc <- data.frame(X = seq_len(nrow(otu.mat)),
                          sample = rownames(otu.mat),
                          otu.mat, check.names = FALSE)

seq.trim.allinfo <- purgeOutliers(seq.formcmc,
                                  count.columns = 3:ncol(seq.formcmc),
                                  sampleZcut = -100,          # keep all 19 mats (same as Summer)
                                  otu.cut = 0.0001, zero.cut = 0.02)

field.purged.ps <- prune_taxa(colnames(seq.trim.allinfo)[-(1:2)], dist.field.git.ps)
field.purged.ps <- prune_samples(seq.trim.allinfo$sample, field.purged.ps)
```


```{r}
## ---------- 3. SENSITIVITY 2: unfiltered, 100-draw averaged rarefied ----------
field.rareavg.ps <- rare.avg.dist.field.git.ps     # already built in the rarefaction chunk
```


```{r}
## ---------- CHECK all three ----------
rbind(filtered = filter_summary(dist.field.git.ps, field.filt.ps),
      purged   = filter_summary(dist.field.git.ps, field.purged.ps),
      rare_avg = c(ntaxa(dist.field.git.ps), ntaxa(field.rareavg.ps),
                   nsamples(field.rareavg.ps), NA))

table(sample_data(field.purged.ps)$Treatment)       # should still be 5 / 4 / 5 / 5
```

~
BETA DIVERSITY MODELS
~

Wrapped in function, so only have to run once - will give results for main model + sensitivity checks
```{r}
run_beta <- function(ps, n_perm = 9999) {
  # ASV table (samples as rows) + matching metadata
  otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) otu <- t(otu)
  md <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))[rownames(otu), , drop = FALSE]

  # CLR by hand (pseudocount 1) -> Euclidean = Aitchison distance
  clr <- log(otu + 1)
  clr <- clr - rowMeans(clr)
  d   <- vegdist(clr, method = "euclidean")
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(md), labels(d)))

  # Dispersion by Treatment
  set.seed(123)
  disp <- betadisper(d, md$Treatment, bias.adjust = TRUE)

  # One-way PERMANOVA
  set.seed(123)
  perm <- adonis2(d ~ Treatment, data = md, permutations = n_perm)

  list(clr = clr, dist = d, md = md, betadisper = disp,
       disp_anova = anova(disp),
       disp_perm  = permutest(disp, pairwise = TRUE, permutations = n_perm),
       permanova  = perm)
}
```

main model
- dispersion fine
- treatment not sig 
```{r}
beta.filt <- run_beta(field.filt.ps)
beta.filt$disp_perm      # dispersion: want p > 0.05
beta.filt$permanova      # Treatment effect
```

~
PCOA plot ~ for visualization
~
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ---------- PCoA of the prevalence-filtered CLR/Euclidean distances ----------
stopifnot(ncol(beta.filt$clr) == ntaxa(field.filt.ps))    
#confirms that the CLR table has the same number of ASVs as the prevalence-filtered object
stopifnot(identical(rownames(beta.filt$md), labels(beta.filt$dist)))
#confirms that the samples in the metadata are in exactly the same order as the samples in the distance matrix.

field.pcoa <- ape::pcoa(beta.filt$dist)
field.pcoa.percent <- round(field.pcoa$values$Relative_eig * 100, 1)
field.pcoa.df <- cbind(
  data.frame(PCoA1 = field.pcoa$vectors[, 1],
             PCoA2 = field.pcoa$vectors[, 2]),
  beta.filt$md
)

# colors matching the rarefaction curve
treatment_colors <- c("ND" = "grey50", "Few Small" = "orange",
                      "Many Small" = "blue3", "HD" = "#984ea3")

# PERMANOVA label pulled from the results
perm <- beta.filt$permanova
perm_label <- sprintf("Treatment: R² = %.3f, p = %.3f", perm$R2[1], perm$`Pr(>F)`[1])

# ---------- PCoA plot: Treatment ellipses + colored points ----------
field.pcoa.plot <- ggplot(field.pcoa.df,
                          aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = Treatment)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = Treatment, fill = Treatment),
               geom = "polygon", level = 0.95,
               alpha = 0.15, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5,
           label = perm_label) +
  labs(title = "Field ASV profiles: CLR/Euclidean PCoA",
       x = paste0("PCoA 1 (", field.pcoa.percent[1], "%)"),
       y = paste0("PCoA 2 (", field.pcoa.percent[2], "%)")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

field.pcoa.plot
#ggsave("Field_PCoA.pdf", field.pcoa.plot, width = 7, height = 5.5)
```

```{r}
res      <- ancom.treat2$res          # each treatment vs ND (main model)
```

```{r}
View(fieldpam)
fieldpam$Treatment <- as.character(fieldpam$Treatment)

#checkassumptions

qqnorm(residuals(fieldpam_model))
qqline(residuals(fieldpam_model), col = "red")
shapiro_test <- shapiro.test(residuals(fieldpam_model))
```
